requirements.summary: A modern, clean landing page featuring a staggered entrance animation. The layout includes a sticky header, a split-pane hero section with text on the left and UI mockups on the right, followed by a logo cloud for investors.
requirements.template_goal: Create a reusable, animated landing page template where colors, typography, and card contents can be easily customized. The entrance animation sequence must be faithfully recreated using CSS or a lightweight animation library.
hard_constraints: The entrance animation must follow the exact staggered sequence observed in the reference: Header -> Background Cards -> Card Contents -> Investor Logos.
The hero section must use a two-column layout with distinct background colors and rounded corners for each column.
The three UI mockup cards in the right hero column must overlap slightly or be positioned to show depth, and must animate in sequentially.
preserve_requirements: The specific serif font for headings and sans-serif for body text.
The generous padding and border radii (approx 24px-32px) on the main hero cards.
The dark green primary color used for text, logos, and buttons.

section_requirements.name: Header
section_requirements.purpose: Site navigation and primary call to action.
section_requirements.layout: Flex container, space-between, items centered vertically.

section_requirements.name: Hero Section
section_requirements.purpose: Main value proposition and visual hook.
section_requirements.layout: CSS Grid, 2 columns (approx 40% / 60% split), with a gap.
must_include: Left card with heading, paragraph, and CTA button.
Right card with three smaller UI mockup cards.
styling: Left card: Light green background, large border radius.
Right card: Light blue/grey background, large border radius.
UI mockup cards: White background, subtle shadow, smaller border radius.
copy_items: Admit more patients, reduce staff burden, and get paid faster with an AI-native system built for behavioral healthcare.
assets: Mockup graphics for EHR and RCM cards
behaviors: Cards slide up and fade in.
Inner elements stagger in after cards.

section_requirements.name: Investor Logos
section_requirements.layout: Flex column, centered text, flex row for logos wrapping as needed.
must_include: Row of at least 6 investor logos
styling: Logos should be greyscale or visually balanced.
behaviors: Fades in after hero animation completes.

layout_requirements: Use a max-width container (e.g., 1280px or 1440px) with auto margins to center the content on large screens.
The hero section should use a grid layout to easily manage the split columns and gap.
The UI cards inside the right hero column should use absolute positioning or negative margins to achieve the overlapping/staggered layout.
styling_requirements: Ensure high contrast for text against the light background cards.
Buttons should have fully rounded corners (pill shape).
Use a serif font for the main hero heading to match the brand feel, and a clean sans-serif for all other text.
copy_requirements: All text must be easily editable via variables or a configuration object.
Maintain exact wording from the reference for the initial template state.
asset_requirements: Use placeholder SVGs or generic images for the UI card contents if exact assets are unavailable, but maintain the layout structure (e.g., an avatar, some text lines, a chart placeholder).
behavior_requirements: The page must not scroll horizontally.
Hover states on buttons should subtly change background color or opacity.
animation_requirements: Initial state: All animated elements have opacity 0. Elements that slide up have transform translateY(40px).
Sequence 2 (300ms): Left green card and right blue card slide up to translateY(0) and fade in (duration 800ms, ease-out).
Sequence 3 (600ms): 'Request a Demo' button in the left card slides up and fades in.
Sequence 4 (700ms, staggered): The three white UI cards in the right column slide up and fade in sequentially (CRM, then EHR, then RCM).
Sequence 5 (1200ms): Investor heading and logos fade in.
structure_guidance: Wrap the entire animated sequence in a container that controls the initial hidden state to prevent flashes of unstyled content.
Use data attributes (e.g., data-animate="slide-up") to tag elements for animation, allowing a single script or CSS file to handle the logic.
execution_plan: 1. Setup HTML skeleton with Tailwind CSS (or equivalent) and define custom color/font tokens in the config.
2. Build the Header component with flexbox.
3. Build the Hero section grid layout. Create the left and right cards with their respective background colors and border radii.
4. Populate the left card with typography and the CTA button.
5. Populate the right card with the three white UI mockup cards, using absolute positioning to arrange them.
7. Implement the CSS keyframes or animation library logic.
8. Apply animation classes/attributes to elements according to the staggered sequence.
9. Test the animation timing and adjust delays to match the reference video.
known_unknowns: The exact font families used (Playfair Display and Inter are assumed based on visual similarity).
The exact hex codes for colors (approximations used).
The content of the section below the fold (only partially visible).

interaction_checkpoints.name: Header Appears
interaction_checkpoints.expected_result: Logo and navigation fade into view.

interaction_checkpoints.name: Hero Backgrounds Appear
interaction_checkpoints.expected_result: Large green and blue cards slide up into position.

interaction_checkpoints.name: Hero Content Appears
interaction_checkpoints.expected_result: Left CTA button and right UI cards slide up into position.

interaction_checkpoints.name: Animation Complete
interaction_checkpoints.expected_result: Investor logos are visible, page is fully interactive.

acceptance_criteria: The layout matches the two-column hero design with correct proportions.
Colors and border radii visually match the reference.
The entrance animation plays automatically on load.
The animation follows the exact staggered sequence: Header -> Backgrounds -> Inner Content -> Logos.
The three UI cards in the right column animate in one after the other, not simultaneously.

validation.summary: The candidate implements the core layout, typography, and color scheme well. The animation sequence is correctly structured in the JavaScript. However, structural CSS issues (overflow clipping and incorrect positioning) prevent the UI cards from overlapping correctly, and several elements (EHR card, RCM card, Investor logos) fail to appear in the final rendered screenshots, likely due to animation timing or initial opacity states not resolving in the capture environment.
strengths: Excellent use of design tokens for colors, typography, and spacing.
The left hero card accurately matches the reference in layout, copy, and styling.
The animation sequence logic in JavaScript correctly targets the required staggered delays.
The internal structure and styling of the individual UI mockup cards are highly accurate.

issues.title: UI Cards Clipped by Container
issues.observed: The right hero container (`.bg-surface-blue`) has `overflow-hidden` applied, which clips the middle EHR card. In the reference, the EHR card breaks out of the top edge of the blue background.
issues.expected: The EHR card should be fully visible and allowed to overflow the top of its blue background container.
issues.fix_instructions: Remove the `overflow-hidden` class from the `<div data-animate="slide-up" class="bg-surface-blue ... overflow-hidden ...">` container.

issues.title: UI Cards Do Not Overlap
issues.observed: The three UI mockup cards (CRM, EHR, RCM) are positioned too far apart horizontally (`left-4` and `right-4`), preventing them from overlapping to create the depth effect seen in the reference.
issues.expected: The CRM and RCM cards should be positioned closer to the center so their inner edges tuck behind the central EHR card.
issues.fix_instructions: Increase the horizontal inset values for the side cards. Change `left-4` to `left-12` or `left-16` on the CRM card, and change `right-4` to `right-12` or `right-16` on the RCM card.

issues.title: Missing Elements in Final Render
issues.observed: The EHR card, RCM card, and the entire Investor Logos section are completely missing from the rendered screenshots. While present in the HTML, their initial `opacity: 0` state does not appear to resolve to visible in the final snapshot.
issues.expected: All animated elements must be fully visible in the final state of the page.
issues.fix_instructions: Ensure the animation sequence completes successfully in the rendering environment. If the screenshot capture occurs before the 1200ms sequence finishes, consider adding a fallback mechanism (e.g., a class added to `<body>` that forces opacity to 1 for static snapshots) or verify the JavaScript execution.

patch_instructions: Locate the right hero container: `<div data-animate="slide-up" class="bg-surface-blue rounded-card-lg p-8 relative overflow-hidden min-h-[540px]">` and remove the `overflow-hidden` class.
Locate the CRM card (`data-card="crm"`) and change its positioning class from `left-4` to `left-16` to force it to overlap with the center card.
Locate the RCM card (`data-card="rcm"`) and change its positioning class from `right-4` to `right-16` to force it to overlap with the center card.
Investigate why elements with delays > 700ms are not rendering in the final snapshot. Ensure the `animate-active` class is successfully applied to the EHR card, RCM card, and Investor section.
